About Initia Airdrop

The Initia Airdrop is more than just an event; it’s a pivotal moment for the Initia community, built on innovation, collaboration, and shared passion. This initiative is designed to reward our vibrant ecosystem by distributing Initia Coins to enthusiasts who believe in the vision of a decentralized and inclusive future. By participating, you join a global network of over 1 billion Initia supporters who are united in their commitment to creativity and progress. The airdrop is an opportunity to connect with like-minded individuals, contribute to a thriving ecosystem, and take an active role in shaping the future of blockchain innovation.

50.5% of Initia Coins Reserved for the Community More than half of the total Initia Coin supply — 50.5% — is dedicated to supporting the community. Through the Lineacoin Foundation's grant initiatives, a significant portion of these Coins will be allocated to talented Initia creators and innovators. These passionate contributors will play a key role in bringing new Initia holders into the ecosystem, ensuring a thriving and sustainable future for the Initia community.

Community Airdrop Details
  • ● Total Allocation: 27,000,000,000 Initia tokens (7.99% of the total supply, reserved for holders and participants).
  • ● Duration: The airdrop will begin within the next 30 days and run for 10 days.
  • ● Participation: Community members can join by submitting their ETH wallet addresses on the official Initia website. Each eligible address will receive an initial allocation of 200 Initia tokens for free.
  • ● Rewards Distribution: Airdrop rewards will be sent to submitted wallet addresses after the event ends. If the total claimed rewards exceed the allocated amount, the event will conclude early. Any unclaimed tokens will be permanently burned.
  • ● Invitation Bonus: Invite friends to participate in the airdrop and earn 200 Initia tokens for each successful referral. You can invite up to 50 friends and earn a maximum of 10,000 Initia tokens. With a limited supply and an estimated token value of $1, Initia offers an exclusive opportunity to participate in the future of blockchain. Don't wait—share this chance with your friends and claim your rewards!
Initia Pre-Sale Details
  • ● Pre-Sale Allocation: 27,000,000 Initia tokens (7.99% of the total supply).
  • ● Pre-Sale Price: 1 ETH = 84,000 Initia tokens.
  • ● Minimum Purchase: 0.05 ETH.
  • ● Maximum Purchase: 20 ETH. Excess ETH sent beyond the limit will be automatically refunded.

The system will automatically transfer the corresponding Initia tokens to your wallet immediately.   • ● Fund Allocation Post Pre-Sale: 50% of the funds raised will be allocated for listing Initia tokens on major exchanges, including Binance, Huobi, and Coinbase. 50% will be used for a strategic token buyback to maintain market stability and reduce potential price volatility from large sell-offs.
